'''Darth Ikoral's fleet''' embarked on an [[Darth Ikoral's expedition|expedition]] in search of other [[Sith (species)/Legends|Sith pureblood]] colonies during the reign of the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|reconstituted Sith Empire]]. A strong believer in the purity of Sith [[Blood/Legends|blood]], [[Darth Ikoral]] was given permission from the [[Dark Council]] to set off with [[Gender/Legends|his]] [[Fleet/Legends|fleet]]. Ikoral's fleet went missing and the [[Sith Lord/Legends|Sith Lord]] was presumed dead by the [[Sith/Legends|Sith]], although Ikoral later returned and attacked both the Empire and the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]]<ref name="TORE" /> with his [[Flagship/Legends|flagship]], the [[Harrower-class dreadnought|''Harrower''-class dreadnought]] ''[[Red Reaper]]''.<ref name="Red Reaper" />
